title: On the robustness verification of binary neural networks
title_zh: 二值神经网络鲁棒性验证的研究
abstract: Abstract Binary neural networks (BNNs) combine strong efficiency gains with a highly discrete structure that gives rise to distinctive robustness and verification challenges. This survey provides a dedicated overview of formal verification methods for BNNs, focusing on robustness properties, threat models, and the trade-offs between exactness, scalability, and strength of guarantees. We organize the literature according to the main verification paradigms proposed in this setting, including SAT/SMT-based methods, optimization-based approaches, reachability analysis, and quantitative or model-counting techniques. We discuss the main ideas behind these approaches, the guarantees they provide, and the practical challenges that remain in verifying BNNs at scale.
abstract_zh: 摘要：二值神经网络（BNNs）兼具显著的效率提升与高度离散的结构，导致其在鲁棒性和验证方面面临独特挑战。本综述专门概述了针对BNNs的形式化验证方法，重点关注鲁棒性属性、威胁模型以及精确度、可扩展性与保证强度之间的权衡。我们按该领域提出的主要验证范式对文献进行分类，包括基于SAT/SMT的方法、基于优化的方案、可达性分析以及定量或模型计数技术。讨论了这些方法背后的核心思想、所提供的保证以及在大规模验证BNNs时仍然存在的实际挑战。
